d:
Anuradha Sehgal (Raveena Tandon) a liberal thinking Delhi based young and dynamic politician, re locates to Mumbai. She accidently meets the state's aspiring Chief Minister, Vivek Chauhan and gets married to him. But, things change soon after their marriage. Watch Anuradha's struggle between life, relationships, corruption and dirty politics.
Star Cast - Raveena Tandon, Atul Kulkarni, Shri Vallabh Vyas, Govind Namdeo, Sameer Dharmadhikari
Director - Madhur Bhandarkar
Producer - Meju Khan
Cinematographer - Madhukar S. Rao
Music Director - Raju Singh
Lyricist - Javed Akhtar
